propositions.claim: Par. 3 requests four department heads to cooperate with the Director and requires each to appoint a representative.
propositions.quote: Each of the said Secretaries and the said Adm inistr a to r shall appoint a representative who shall, upon request of the Director, confer with him

propositions.claim: Par. 4 makes the order effective retroactively from July 1, 1939.

Paragraph 2 expressly authorizes projects on county, municipal, and privately owned lands, subject to section 3 limitations.
Paragraph 3 names the four officials, requests cooperation, and requires each to appoint a representative.
Paragraph 4 states: 'This order shall take effect as of July 1, 1939.'
